notes.title: Steam Cloud saves, Bugfix, Chinese, Hungarian and Polish !
notes.notes:
[h3]🎮 Hi fellow rogue-lite enthousiasts 🎮[/h3]

Still working on fallback, we're making quality of life improvements and bringing back some languages that were available before the update but we needed a bit more time to have them updated ;)

Update will be available today !

[h2]Patch note[/h2]

[list]
[*]Chinese is back in the game ! 
[*]Hungarian and Polish have been updated as well
[*]Added support of steam cloud saves 
[*]Debug tool updated 
[*]Minor fixes 
[/list]


May the depths be with you 👊

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
[b]New Features[/b]
[*] Cinematic can now be skipped
[*] Added New interface for interactions
[*] Added support for PS4 controller
[*] Added support for Vsync
[*] Added in-game news feed 


[b]Bug Fix [/b]

[i]Sentinel[/i]
[*] Correction of a bug allowing to kill it without launching the cinematic 
[*] Correction of a bug with final achievement after taking the final teleporter
[*] Correction of a bug that made mortars invisible
[*] Correction of a bug that caused insane damage values on slow roll (from [i]500[/i] to [i]50[/i])
[*] Fixed lighting AMD GPUs
[*] Fixed Console screens on AMD GPUs
[*] Fixed automatic language detection using steam settings

[b]Convenience[/b]

Added new indication on who to speak to when you finish a boss

[b]Balance [/b]

[*] Perks costs slightly increased
[*] Maximum shield overcharge is now [i]10[/i]
[*] Base level modules are now required for higher-level modules to appear. 

[u]Classes:[/u]

[i]Technophobe: [/i]
damage increased from [i]3-5[/i] to [i]5-7[/i]

[i]Seismologist: [/i]
Shield reduced from [i]110-130[/i] to [i]80-100[/i]
Damaged reduced from [i]13-15[/i] to [i]12-14[/i]

[u]Modules:[/u]

Chances to receive a legendary module reduced from [i]10%[/i] to [i]5%[/i]
Chances to receive an epic module reduced from [i]20%[/i] to [i]15%[/i]

[i]AGILITY BOOST: [/i]
[strike]After an attack, a successful dodge recharges your shield by [X]%[/strike]
Doing a dodge after a successful attack recharges your shield by [X]%

[i]TANK:[/i]
[strike]Your attack recharges your shield by [X]% of your damages.[/strike]
Every [X] strikes, your attack recharges your shield by [X]% of your damages.

[i]PREVENTIVE SHIELD:[/i]
Fixed to proc once per attack done
Charge reduced from [i]50/100/150%[/i] to [i]30/50/80%[/i] of your last attack

[i]GOD OF WAR: [/i]
[strike]Your max health is reduced by [i]90%[/i] but your damaged increase by [i]100/150/200%[/i][/strike]
Your damage increases by [i]100/150/200%[/i] but your shield can no longer load and you can not get any more healing.

[i]SHIELD TRANSFER:[/i]
Excess healing and excess shield transferred reduced from [i]50/70/100[/i] to [i]20/40/60[/i]

[i]HOLD ON:[/i]
The maximum shield is now a fixed value instead of a percentage

[i]PREPARATION:[/i]
Shield gained reduced from [i]150/200/400%[/i] to [i]50/100/150%[/i]

[u]Ennemies:[/u]

[i]The Sentinel[/i]
[*] Now has a shield
[*] Reduction of damage on power roll 

[i]Alpha experiment[/i] 
[*] Now has a shield

[i]Mortar:[/i]
[*] Health point reduced from[i] 150[/i] to [i]100[/i]
[*] Main gun damage reduced from [i]50 [/i]to [i]30[/i]
[*] Main gun firing sequence increased from [i]0.3[/i] sec to [i]0.5s[/i]
[/list]

_____________________

[b]
Thank you for your help and support! The team is now working on the next patch (28/10). More on that very soon. [/b]
